listings.name: Kalk Bay Books
listings.address: 62 Main Road, Kalk Bay, Cape Town, 7975
listings.current_description: Kalk Bay Books is an independent bookshop in the seaside village of Kalk Bay, trading since 2006 and stocking a curated range of new and used fiction and non-fiction for all ages.

listings.name: Kehl's Upholstery Suppliers
listings.address: 403 Voortrekker Road, Maitland, Cape Town, 7405
listings.current_description: Kehl's Upholstery Suppliers has supplied upholstery fabric, vinyl, foam and trimming supplies to Cape Town's interior decorators, upholsterers and motor-trimming trade since the late 1960s, operating from its landmark Maitland premises since 1988.

listings.name: Kingdom Kidz Educare Academy
listings.address: 6 Topsham Road, Ottery East, Cape Town, 7800
listings.current_description: Kingdom Kidz Educare Academy is a daycare and crèche in Ottery East offering an English-medium early learning programme for babies from 3 months through preschoolers up to age 5, spanning crèche, toddler and preschool stages.

listings.name: Kirstenhof Bookshop
listings.address: 254 Main Road, Kirstenhof, Cape Town, 7945
listings.current_description: Kirstenhof Bookshop is a charity bookshop run by Help the Rural Child, selling second-hand and donated books from its Main Road premises in Kirstenhof, with proceeds supporting rural children's programmes run by the Goedgedacht Trust in the Swartland.

listings.name: Kluk CGDT
listings.address: 43-45 Bree Street, Cape Town, 8001
listings.current_description: Kluk CGDT is a Cape Town fashion label based in its own showroom and design studio on Bree Street, producing ready-to-wear, bridal and couture collections with a distinctive, colourful South African aesthetic.

listings.name: Lakeside Brewing Co Taproom
listings.address: Imhoff Farm, Kommetjie Road, Kommetjie, Cape Town, 7975
listings.current_description: Lakeside Brewing Co Taproom is a craft brewery and taproom at Imhoff Farm in Kommetjie, established in 2013, offering a range of house-brewed beer styles and a fully stocked bar with indoor and outdoor seating, run in collaboration with Blue Water Cafe.

listings.name: Lakeside Clothing
listings.address: 105 Main Road, Lakeside, Cape Town, 7945
listings.current_description: Lakeside Clothing is a small, mother-and-son-run second-hand clothing shop on Main Road, restocked with seasonal clothing donated by locals from Lakeside and Muizenberg, with a colourful interior of hats, scarves, bags and other finds.

listings.name: Lavender Hill High School
listings.address: 91 Grindal Ave, Lavender Hill, Cape Town, 7945
listings.current_description: Lavender Hill High School is a public co-educational secondary school in Lavender Hill, established in 1978 and teaching in both Afrikaans and English. It offers subjects including History, Geography, Consumer Studies and Computer Application Technology, alongside sports facilities such as a hockey astroturf, rugby field and soccer astroturf.

listings.name: Lentegeur Hospital
listings.address: Highlands Drive, Lentegeur, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town, 7785
listings.current_description: Lentegeur Hospital is the largest of the Western Cape's four level-2 mental health hospitals, with 722 inpatient beds across Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, Forensic Psychiatry, Intellectual Disability Services and General Adult Psychiatry units. It also serves as a psychiatric training facility for the Universities of Cape Town and Stellenbosch.

listings.name: Live Bait
listings.address: Kalk Bay Harbour, Kalk Bay, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Live Bait is a seafood restaurant built on the breakwater at Kalk Bay Harbour, open since 1999, serving sushi, calamari, line fish and seafood platters alongside other non-seafood options, with views over False Bay and the working harbour.

listings.name: Louis' On The Block
listings.address: Corner Children's Way & Hiddingh Road, Bergvliet, Cape Town, 7945
listings.current_description: Louis' On The Block is a family-run steakhouse and pizzeria on the corner of Children's Way and Hiddingh Road in Bergvliet, serving grilled steaks, fresh seafood and wood-fired pizzas alongside a dedicated kids' menu.

listings.name: Lwandle Migrant Labour Museum
listings.address: Old Community Hall, Vulindlela Street, Lwandle, 7140
listings.current_description: The Lwandle Migrant Labour Museum is a township heritage museum in Lwandle, housed in a preserved former migrant-labour hostel and opened in 2000, documenting the history of hostel life and forced removals under apartheid through exhibits including personal artefacts, workplace stories, and the preserved Hostel 33.

listings.name: Maartens Guesthouse
listings.address: 39 Avenue Normandie, Fresnaye, Cape Town, 8005
listings.current_description: Maartens Guesthouse is a stately Fresnaye bed and breakfast with a rooftop terrace and lush garden, set on the slopes of Lions Head between Camps Bay and the city bowl, with a tranquil salt-water swimming pool, free Wi-Fi and parking, and flat-screen TVs in every room.

listings.name: Mancelle's Locksmiths
listings.address: Shop 8, Corner Viking & Odin Road, Thornton, Cape Town, 7460
listings.current_description: Mancelle's Locksmiths offers locksmithing services including key cutting, supply and fitting of locks, motor vehicle and motorcycle key coding, and alarm remotes for cars and gates, inside Viking Place Convenience Centre, Thornton.

listings.name: MaNeo's B&B and Catering
listings.address: Zone 7 No 30, Langa, Cape Town
listings.current_description: MaNeo's B&B and Catering is a bed and breakfast in Zone 7, Langa, and was the first township B&B to open in Langa, in 1999; it offers three guest rooms -- one in the main house and two in outbuildings -- with African meals available on request.

listings.name: Mantelli's Direct
listings.address: 9A Bell Crescent, Westlake Business Park, Westlake, Cape Town, 7945
listings.current_description: Mantelli's Direct Westlake is a factory-direct outlet of the Mantelli's biscuit and rusk brand, selling individually wrapped biscuits, rusks and cookies at factory prices in food-service and retail packs, including Kosher and Halal options.

listings.name: Marian RC Secondary School
listings.address: St Dominic Street, Matroosfontein, Cape Town, 7490
listings.current_description: Marian RC Secondary School is a public Roman Catholic secondary school on St Dominic Street, Matroosfontein, classified as a quintile 4 Section 21 school responsible for its own stationery, textbook and maintenance budgets.

listings.name: Marina Pub and Bistro
listings.address: Shop 36, Eastlake Shopping Centre, Eastlake Drive, Marina Da Gama, Muizenberg, Cape Town, 7945
listings.current_description: Marina Pub and Bistro is a pub and bistro in Eastlake Shopping Centre, Marina Da Gama, serving pub-style meals such as burgers, ribs and pizza alongside a range of craft beers, and hosting regular events including quiz nights.

listings.name: Mdzananda Animal Clinic
listings.address: 21297 Govan Mbeki Road, Mandela Park, Khayelitsha, Cape Town, 7784
listings.current_description: Mdzananda Animal Clinic is a veterinary-council-registered non-profit clinic founded in 1996, providing low-cost and subsidised veterinary care, sterilisation and pet-health education to the Khayelitsha community, and running mobile clinics into the wider area.

listings.name: Merrydale Primary School
listings.address: 20 Merrydale Lane, Lentegeur, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town, 7785
listings.current_description: Merrydale Primary School is a no-fee public primary school in Lentegeur, Mitchells Plain, that has served the community for more than 40 years. As of a 2023 survey it had around 999 learners and 29 educators, and it stopped offering Grade 8 in 2013 as local high schools took over that intake.

listings.name: Metro Organics
listings.address: Outside The Foodbarn Deli, Noordhoek Farm Village, Cnr Noordhoek Main Road & Village Lane, Noordhoek, Cape Town, 7979
listings.current_description: Metro Organics is a family-run urban organic farm and greengrocer that has operated a shop at Noordhoek Farm Village since 2020, supplying locally grown organic vegetables and produce to the surrounding community.

listings.name: Mitchells Plain Community Health Centre
listings.address: 1st Avenue, Eastridge, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town, 7785
listings.current_description: Mitchells Plain Community Health Centre is a public primary healthcare facility providing free clinical services, including maternity care, to Eastridge and surrounding communities such as Philippi, Samora Machel, Weltevrede Park, Mandalay and Marikana.

listings.name: MLV Law
listings.address: 1 Metrohm House, 20 Gardner Williams Avenue, Somerset West
listings.current_description: MLV Law is a Somerset West law firm handling litigation, family law, labour law, property law, and commercial law, as well as wills, estates and trusts, arbitration, dispute resolution and debt collection.

listings.name: Mouille Point Village
listings.address: Westridge, 93 Beach Road, Mouille Point, Cape Town, 8001
listings.current_description: Mouille Point Village is a self-catering apartment complex on Beach Road in Mouille Point offering studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom units with sea, Signal Hill, or Lion's Head views and an on-site swimming pool.

listings.name: Mr Price Home 3 Arts Plumstead
listings.address: 260 Main Road, 3Arts Village, Plumstead, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Mr Price Home 3 Arts Plumstead is a homeware and decor store in the 3 Arts Village Shopping Centre, part of the Mr Price Home retail chain, stocking furniture, home decor and soft furnishings.

listings.name: Much Asphalt
listings.address: 3 Ryneveld Street corner Stasie Rd, Penhill, Eerste River, Cape Town, 7103
listings.current_description: Much Asphalt is the largest commercial asphalt producer in Southern Africa, and this Eerste River plant in Penhill serves as its head office, supplying hot and cold asphalt products to the road construction industry.

listings.name: Mzamomhle Clinic
listings.address: Sagwityi Road, Browns Farm, Philippi, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Mzamomhle Clinic is a public primary health care clinic on Sagwityi Road in Browns Farm, Philippi, part of the Nyanga Health District. It provides general healthcare services including child, women's and men's health, TB, HIV and STI care, and substance abuse support.

listings.name: News Cafe
listings.address: Shop G14, The Sanctuary Shopping Centre, Niblick Way, Firgrove Rural, 7110
listings.current_description: News Cafe in The Sanctuary Shopping Centre is the Firgrove branch of a South African all-day cafe, cocktail bar and entertainment venue chain, serving breakfast, lunch and cocktails into the early hours on weekends.

listings.name: Nonny's Bakery & Cafe
listings.address: Main Road, Masiphumelele, Cape Town, 7975
listings.current_description: Nonny's Bakery & Cafe is a small township bakery and cafe on Masiphumelele's Main Road, open since 2012 and serving fresh-baked cakes, muffins and light lunches such as pies, stews, toasted sandwiches and burgers, with garden seating out back.

listings.name: ORKA Paddles
listings.address: 391 Main Road, Kirstenhof, Cape Town, 7965
listings.current_description: ORKA Paddles is a specialist surfski and kayak paddling shop in Kirstenhof that manufactures its own paddles and also stocks Fenn kayaks and Carbonology surfskis, with an on-site Thule fitment centre for roof racks and accessories.

listings.name: Palm Tyre Service
listings.address: 10 Cannon Street, Maitland, Cape Town, 7405
listings.current_description: Palm Tyre Service is a family-owned tyre and wheel specialist on Cannon Street, Maitland, operating since 1946, offering tyre fitment, balancing, wheel alignment and puncture repair, including specialist fitment for all-terrain and cross-ply tyres.

listings.name: Paul Bothner Music
listings.address: Shop G7, Richmond Centre, Main Road, Plumstead, Cape Town, 7800
listings.current_description: Paul Bothner Music's Plumstead branch, in the Richmond Centre, is a two-floor musical instrument superstore stocking guitars, drum kits, keyboards, orchestral instruments and PA and recording equipment, with in-store music teachers offering lessons.

listings.name: Peacock Tea and Coffee
listings.address: Shop G11, Howard Centre, Corner Howard & Forest Drive, Pinelands, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Peacock Tea and Coffee is a specialist tea and coffee retailer in Howard Centre, Pinelands, sourcing fine teas and gourmet coffee beans from around the world alongside brewing equipment, accessories and crockery, and grinding beans to order.

listings.name: PEP Cavalier Belhar
listings.address: Shop 10, Cavalier Shopping Centre, Modderdam Road, Belhar, Cape Town, 7493
listings.current_description: PEP is a South African discount retail chain founded in 1965 and part of the Pepkor group, with around 1,800 stores across Southern Africa selling affordable clothing, footwear and homeware; this branch trades from Cavalier Shopping Centre in Belhar.

listings.name: PEP Charlesville Mall
listings.address: Shop 17, Charlesville Mall, Cnr Valhalla Drive & Charles Calvert Road, Charlesville, Matroosfontein, Cape Town, 7490
listings.current_description: PEP is a South African discount retail chain founded in 1965 and part of the Pepkor group, with around 1,800 stores across Southern Africa selling affordable clothing, footwear and homeware; this branch trades from Charlesville Mall in Matroosfontein.

listings.name: PEP
listings.address: Shop 22A/B/F, Eerste River City Centre, Forest Drive, Eerste River, Cape Town, 7100
listings.current_description: PEP is a South African discount retail chain founded in 1965 and part of the Pepkor group, with around 1,800 stores across Southern Africa selling affordable clothing, footwear and homeware; this branch trades from Eerste River City Centre.

listings.name: PEP Philippi Shopping Centre
listings.address: Shop 13, Shoprite Centre, Cnr Lansdowne & New Eisleben, Philippi, Cape Town, 7758
listings.current_description: PEP is a South African budget clothing and homeware retailer founded in Upington in 1965 by Renier van Rooyen; now a Pepkor subsidiary with around 1,800 stores across Southern Africa, this branch trades from the Philippi Shopping Centre in Philippi.

listings.name: Philippi Groente Verpakkers
listings.address: Olieboom Road, Schaapkraal, Philippi Horticultural Area, Cape Town, 7941
listings.current_description: Philippi Groente Verpakkers is a fresh produce packing and distribution business in the Philippi Horticultural Area, supplying fruit and vegetables to retailers and traders while also selling directly to the public from its premises.

listings.name: Pick n Pay 3Arts Village
listings.address: 260 Main Road, 3Arts Village, Plumstead, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Pick n Pay 3Arts Village is a supermarket in the 3 Arts Village Shopping Centre in Plumstead, part of the Pick n Pay grocery chain, stocking groceries, fresh produce and household goods.

listings.name: Pick n Pay Local Boston
listings.address: 45 Twelfth Avenue, Boston, Bellville, Cape Town, 7530
listings.current_description: Pick n Pay Local Boston is a neighbourhood branch of the Pick n Pay grocery chain on Twelfth Avenue in Boston, Bellville, stocking a wide range of everyday groceries and offering freshly prepared pancakes.

listings.name: Pick n Pay Tableview
listings.address: Tableview Shopping Centre, Cnr Blaauwberg Rd & Otto du Plessis Rd, Table View, Cape Town, 7441
listings.current_description: Pick n Pay Tableview is a supermarket branch of the retail chain inside Tableview Shopping Centre in Table View, offering fresh produce and general groceries on the corner of Blaauwberg and Otto du Plessis roads.

listings.name: Pizza Perfect Brackenfell Corner
listings.address: Brackenfell Corner Shopping Centre, Frans Conradie Drive, Brackenfell, Cape Town, 7560
listings.current_description: Pizza Perfect Brackenfell Corner is a pizzeria in Brackenfell Corner, Brackenfell, part of a franchise operating since 1989 with more than 100 stores nationwide, serving pizza, pasta, burgers and other fast food for dine-in and delivery.

listings.name: Plant
listings.address: 87 Victoria Road, The Promenade, Camps Bay, Cape Town, 8005
listings.current_description: Plant is an entirely vegan cafe inside The Promenade on Victoria Road in Camps Bay, serving breakfast through dinner with dishes from nachos and hand-crafted burgers to Asian tapas, including a vegan bobotie and seitan bao buns.

listings.name: Playtex Factory Shop
listings.address: 6 & 7 Brickfield Park, Brickfield Road, Salt River, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Playtex Factory Shop is a factory outlet in Salt River selling surplus stock from ladies' lingerie brands Playtex and Wonderbra, men's underwear label Bear, and a range of socks at reduced prices.

listings.name: Portuguese Club
listings.address: 10 Donegal Street, Rugby, Cape Town, 7405
listings.current_description: The Portuguese Club in Rugby is a Portuguese restaurant, sports bar and social club with two function rooms seating 60 to 400 guests and an in-house caterer, hosting weddings, parties and functions as well as monthly community lunches on the first Sunday of each month.

listings.name: Radebe's Bed and Breakfast
listings.address: 23 PW Mama Way, Settlers Place, Langa, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Radebe's Bed and Breakfast is a family-run guesthouse in Settlers Place, Langa, open since 2005, with three themed guest bedrooms and a coffee shack serving continental or African breakfasts, with lunch and dinner also available on request.

listings.name: Rex Hardware
listings.address: Bergsig Centre, Springfontein Avenue, Stellenberg, Bellville, 7530
listings.current_description: Rex Hardware is a general hardware store at Bergsig Centre in Stellenberg, opposite Stellenberg Primary School, stocking plumbing, painting, gardening and lighting supplies, and has traded from the same location for more than 20 years.

listings.name: RHOG Engineering
listings.address: Unit 9, 11 Donnington Rd, Killarney Gardens, 7441
listings.current_description: RHOG Engineering is a precision engineering workshop in Killarney Gardens specialising in machining and producing spares, along with the servicing and maintenance of factory machinery and equipment to keep client downtime to a minimum.

listings.name: Rocklands Clinic
listings.address: Cnr Lancaster Road & Park Avenue, Rocklands, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town, 7785
listings.current_description: Rocklands Clinic is a City of Cape Town public primary healthcare facility on the corner of Lancaster Road and Park Avenue, offering child health, HIV care and testing, family planning, STI assessment and treatment, vaccinations and basic antenatal care on a walk-in basis.

listings.name: Rocklands Pharmacy
listings.address: BP Garage, Cnr Caravelle Street & Handley-Page, Rocklands, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town, 7785
listings.current_description: Rocklands Pharmacy operates from the BP garage on the corner of Caravelle Street and Handley-Page in Rocklands, offering prescription dispensing and over-the-counter medicine with a focus on affordable pricing for the local community, and is registered on the Woolworths Healthcare Fund pharmacy network.
